turns.prompt: Add a footer with the project name to the web app.

# ALIGN: Add a site footer

Version: 1 · Status: draft

# Goal

Every page of the web app ends with a footer that shows the project name. The footer sits below the main content and uses the app's muted text color.

Intention: visitors always see which project they are on.

---

# Todos

## 1 · Footer component        (subagent)
- Goal: a footer on every page.
- Done when: the footer journey passes.

---

# Summary

- What: a footer with the project name on every page
- When you are needed: none
- Approval authorizes: commits and a PR to the web app
